criteria.statement: Bahia publishes one signed, complete 30900 deployment-inventory snapshot per environment listing every Bahia service state with target/environment, deployment unit, runtime, desired immutable ref, observed digest/version, health, drift, source, and observed_at.
Stopped, unhealthy, stale, unmanaged, desired-only, observed-only, and drift-pending cases are explicit, deterministic, and never omitted.
tests: deployment-inventory.test.js: renders signed observed, stopped, desired-only...
deployment-inventory.test.js: marks observations and instances stale...

criteria.statement: Multiple environments and multiple supervised instances of one service remain distinct rows/instances.
Deployment and rollback update the inventory from authoritative observation without a frontend rebuild; unchanged snapshots are deduplicated.
The frontend row is not fabricated as deployed; build provenance is a separate diagnostics section and discovery is not inventory.
tests: version.test.js: never derives deployed state from discovery or build metadata

criteria.statement: Split backend/relay topology (nostr.sidecar.enabled=false) publishes system discovery and the inventory.
The browser accepts only trusted, correctly signed events, applies addressable ordering and tombstones, rejects malformed payloads without clobbering, revalidates cache, and survives reconnect.
No secrets or raw runtime detail (hosts, container IDs, env values, commands, mounts, failure messages) enter any public event; unmanaged instances appear only as per-target counts (option B).
tests: deployment-inventory.test.js: shows only redacted unmanaged aggregates

criteria.statement: Per-instance unmanaged detail is returned only to authorized requesters over an encrypted response.

Live edge-01 acceptance compares rendered inventory with Docker/Compose and Bahia observation records, exercises stale/unmanaged cases and update/rollback, and proves no secrets in events or rendered output.
